job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2024 RFP issued by the City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System, not TRS Illinois. Its required qualifications do not include certification that the firm currently serves clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: Request for Proposal General Investment Consultant Proposals must be submitted on or before 5:00 p.m. Central Standard Time February 9, 2024 City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System
The City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System (COAERS) seeks general investment consultant services in accordance with the specifications contained in this Request for Proposal (“RFP”).
The firm must have at least two U.S. public pension fund clients, each with assets in excess of one billion U.S. dollars as of December 31, 2023.
